examples.description: Render folded stacks using the exact bundled Perl runtime.
Collapse explicitly supplied perf-script records without capturing hardware measurements.

notes: The exact source commit has no reliable conventional --version interface. The version check verifies SHA-256 and byte counts of the three qualified scripts against the pinned original archive; complete material integrity remains a separate package-inventory check.

The functional fixture sends three synthetic perf-script records with periods 300, 200 and 100 through the actual upstream converter, checks exact folded paths/weights, verifies ordinary and differential SVG frames, and requires invalid folded input to fail with exit 2. The total weight 600 is not a claim that 600 samples were captured.
This resource preserves the complete upstream tree and all notices. Individual upstream files can carry different license notices; consult each original file when redistributing.

Default horizontal order is not a time axis. Width describes the selected stack weight; the meaning of that weight depends on the profiler/event. Use --countname for explicit units such as bytes, time or synthetic weights.
Use the same event, units, symbolization and collection policy when comparing profiles. difffolded.pl -n explicitly normalizes totals; whether normalization is appropriate is an experimental choice.
Profile collection, symbolization, kernel permissions and PMU access belong to the selected profiler. Conversion/rendering does not require root and does not establish a benchmark score.

Perl is an exact declared system dependency. Private qualification uses its locked Debian executable, loader, libraries and modules with ambient module fallback disabled; it does not claim an APT or PackageManager installation transaction.
The source artifact retains the original archive; the material artifact retains the complete ready-to-copy script tree. No native compilation is required for these scripts.
Source and binary are installed-envelope methods for interpreted scripts; no machine-code compiler or hardware capture was run.
The original source and its notices are unchanged. The exact 21-package historical private Perl closure is retained as fixed Debian inputs and unpacked below this prefix.
The host apt.perl version is not used; declared Python3 is used only for build/check helpers. No host APT transaction is performed.
Invoke bin/flamegraph, bin/stackcollapse-perf or bin/difffolded for the private interpreter; the unmodified upstream *.pl shebangs remain original source material.
